newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Pingguo Jan-May aluminium output 52,000 T.
newsitem.headline: China's Pingguo Jan-May aluminium output 52,000 T.

text.p: China's Pingguo Aluminium Smelter in southwestern Guangxi region produced 52,000 tonnes of electrolytic aluminium in the first five months, company officials said on Friday.
The smelter has set a target of 100,000 tonnes for electrolytic aluminium production in 1997, an official of the smelter said.
"We can definitely achieve the goal," the official said by telephone from Pingguo county in Guangxi.
Sales had been brisk in neighbouring Guangdong province, where a property boom has pushed up consumption of aluminium materials, he said.
The Pingguo smelter produced about 150,000 tonnes of aluminium oxide in the first five months, the official said. It plans to produce 300,000 tonnes in 1997.
"We don't expect any exports this year," a second smelter official said. The company exported 600 tonnes of aluminium ingots in 1996 to register on the London Metal Exchange.
The smelter produced 80,000 tonnes of electrolytic aluminium and 250,000 tonnes of aluminium oxide in 1996, officials said, but gave no further details.
